summary: Rebuilds no longer leak kernel memory. Replicad 1.1's fuse, cut and intersect leave their native builder to garbage collection and never delete the raw result handle, which keeps each result's topology alive for the life of the kernel module; its translate, rotate, mirror and scale also leak their builder and raw handle and consume their input; and its Plane builds coordinate transforms the kernel never reads, leaking a gp_Trsf and two gp_Ax3 for every sketch placement. The kernel now runs these operations through owned adapters in cadKernelBuilders.ts: fuse, cut and common; translate, rotate, mirror and scale, which leave their input intact; and all-edge fillet and chamfer. Each repeats Replicad's native calls exactly, including the second Build() and SimplifyResult(true, true, 0.001) after a boolean's constructor, which is part of today's geometry, borrows its inputs, returns a new shape and deletes its builder, raw result and every temporary in finally, also when the native operation throws. Sketch placement uses CadKernelPlane, which owns only the origin, x direction and normal that Replicad's Plane gives; the sketch axis, faces with holes, the extrusion vector and the revolve axis are built and deleted by the kernel. Replicad's curve start, end, point and tangent queries, Face.normalAt, makePln and Drawing.translate and rotate also leaked the point Value returns, the gp_XYZ each Vector copies or a gp_Trsf2d on every rebuild, topology inspection and section: cadKernelQueries.ts and owned profile transforms in cadKernelSketch.ts repeat their native calls, give the same numbers and curves and delete everything, and the shell deletes the copy of its opening face that NCollection_List.Append returns. Replicad's pen deleted its points and curve maker only after a curve was made, so every rebuild that OpenCascade refused a profile line or arc left two or three gp_Pnt2d and the maker behind; cadKernelPen.ts now draws every profile with Replicad's pen calls, arithmetic and orientation checks, so the curves are the same, deletes every point and maker also when a line or arc is refused, and reports such a profile as invalid-profile instead of kernel-operation-failed. Volumes, areas and bounding boxes are measured with the native calls of Replicad's measureVolume, measureArea and boundingBox, which left their property objects and boxes to garbage collection, and deleted. Extrude, Revolve, booleans, Join, Cut, linear and circular patterns, Mirror, Transform, loft, segment sweep, Pocket and inch STL import use the adapters; Shell and selected-edge fillet and chamfer already owned their builders. Over 100 rebuilds of each part in one module, with the event loop turning between rebuilds as in the worker, OpenCascade memory grew by 27.1 to 244.1 MiB on 5 of 12 parts at 0.0.789 and by none at 0.0.793; rebuilt back to back it grew by up to 979.1 MiB, and an imported STL body cut by a slot grew from 1,543.1 to 4,023.1 MiB, where 5 of 100 rebuilds failed. At 0.0.793 every part keeps its working size and no counted builder, transform or coordinate system is left; these figures were measured before the query, profile transform and shell fixes, which delete further small objects. Build time is not slower. In 36 back-to-back pairs of 15 uncached builds, three rounds for each of the 12 parts with every pair that another process overlapped run again, the best minimum build time at 0.0.793 is 0 to 6% below 0.0.789's on every part. The legacy kernel benchmark ran throttled on a shared host, so its build and edit times are not compared, but its memory after 50 edits fell from 127.1 to 100 MiB for the holed plate and from 238.9 to 199.1 MiB for the gear and plate. The booleans read SimplifyResult's angular tolerance, Replicad's 0.001 rad within which tangent faces and edges of the result merge, from the new angular precision role kernelBooleanSimplifyRad; the precision version stays 2, as no role changes value or meaning.
warning: No breaking change for installed posts, machine packages, saved revisions, CAD files or controller output. Geometry is unchanged: every part in the parity set, every benchmark step among them, builds byte-identical preview buffers, volumes, solid counts and bounds, and each adapter returns the same BRep as the Replicad call it replaces.

checklist.schema: No CAD document, sketch, UPID, post, machine package, saved revision, worker message, storage or journal change. Post engine API remains 1 and saved-job engine remains 3. CAD_PRECISION_VERSION stays 2: the new angular role kernelBooleanSimplifyRad carries the 0.001 rad Replicad already passed as SimplifyResult's angular tolerance, so no role changes value or meaning and no cache keyed on it is invalidated. The new role kernelProfilePointMm carries the 1e-6 mm within which Replicad's pen already treated two profile points as the same, so it changes no value either.
checklist.events: No execution event, cancellation, input-version or WebMCP change. A rebuild runs the same native operations in the same order and deletes their builders and temporaries as it goes. A profile whose line or arc OpenCascade refuses stops the rebuild at the same feature as before, now with the diagnostic invalid-profile and a message naming the line or arc instead of kernel-operation-failed with a script error; no code reads either diagnostic code.
checklist.capabilities: No post or machine capability change and no new application controls.
checklist.auditAndOutput: No generation, audit, numbering, encoding, line ending, feed or controller-file change. Kernel geometry, previews and STEP and STL exports are unchanged.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No installed package, revision, browser-cache or folder storage change.
checklist.verification: Since review round 2: Replicad's threePointsArcTo and lineTo deleted their points and curve maker only after a curve was made; a maker given coincident or collinear points is not done and its Value is null, so every rejected rebuild left two gp_Pnt2d and a GC_MakeSegment2d or three gp_Pnt2d and a GC_MakeArcOfCircle2d. cadKernelPen.ts now draws every profile, repeating Replicad's draw lines, three-point and sagitta arcs and close, drawCircle and drawRoundedRectangle without corners, owns every point and maker through cadKernelScope and deletes the curves a failed drawing made; a refused line or arc is invalid-profile. The new precision role kernelProfilePointMm, 1e-6 mm, is Replicad's samePoint, pinned in the version 2 record; CAD_PRECISION_VERSION stays 2. Every other Replicad call on a build path was checked: measureVolume, measureArea and Shape.boundingBox left their GProp_GProps or Bnd_Box to garbage collection, and cadKernelVolume, cadKernelArea and cadKernelBounds make the same calls and delete them; topology descriptors own their circle, plane and cylinder and each location, axis and direction as soon as it is made; what remains is cast and the wrapper classes, which make no temporary a failure can skip. The rebuild-memory suite now uses watchEveryCadKernelNativeObject, which reads every class from the OpenCascade module and records every object any constructor makes and any instance method or static function returns, labelled with the defining class, before garbage collection and with no exemption; it sees GeomAdaptor_TransformedCurve.Circle and BRepOffsetAPI_ThruSections, and a negative control leaks a curve adaptor with its Circle, Location, Axis and Direction, plane and cylinder surface adaptors with Plane, Cylinder, Location and Axis, a loft builder, a refused arc maker and its three points, a GProp_GProps with CentreOfMass and a Bnd_Box, sees each exactly and nothing once they are deleted. Correction: this OpenCascade build has no Handle_ classes, as a handle result is an object of the class it points to, so the round 1 probe's Handle_ filter excluded nothing. The review's sector of radius 1,000,000 mm and sweep 0.0000001 degrees, extruded by 1 mm, rebuilt 5 times in a fresh module is refused as invalid-profile each time with nothing outstanding; whether OpenCascade makes that arc depends on what ran earlier in the module, and after other builds it makes it and the extrusion is refused as empty-solid, so a second test accepts either refusal and still requires nothing outstanding over 5 rebuilds. As exactly collinear points were also refused in one probe sequence and made in another, tests that must refuse a line or arc inject the refusal: the holed box with its second half circle or third rectangle side refused, rebuilt 5 times, leaves nothing. cadKernelPen.test.ts draws 12 shapes, among them a 0.001 mm circle, a rectangle of zero width, clockwise and major arcs, sagitta arcs to either side, an outline ending 0.0000005 mm from its start and an arc through three coincident points, with Replicad's curves and, for the 9 non-degenerate ones, its wire, each leaving only the curves its drawing owns; a zero-length line, a zero-length side and an arc or closing line OpenCascade refuses are invalid-profile with nothing outstanding, where Replicad's controls leave the points and maker; orientation failures and a throwing step delete what they made. The builder parity suite adds translate by zero, rotate by 0 and 360 degrees, scale by 1, and a cut and a common with a shape that does not meet the target, each with Replicad's BRep and its builder deleted also when the builder fails; a fillet and a chamfer larger than the box, a rotation about a zero axis and zero extrusion and revolve directions throw OpenCascade's exception from both, the owned adapters leaving nothing and Replicad its builder or transform and vectors; profile translation by zero and rotation by 0 and 360 degrees equal Replicad's. Mutation round 4: 52 mutations against the 149 tests of the adapter, pen and rebuild-memory suites, each reverted, and every one fails. Round 3's 20 fail again, 1 to 30 tests each. Removing the pen's ownership of a line's maker or either of its points fails 31 tests, of an arc's maker or middle point 25 and of its first point 22; skipping the line and arc refusal checks fails 4 and 3; keeping a line or arc whose orientation fails 1 each, and a failed drawing's curves 7; and cadKernelScope's disposal 37. The bounds box fails 14, and the volume and area property objects 15 and 3. Removing the descriptor's ownership of its circle, the review's mutation, fails 4, as do its curve adaptor, location, axis and direction; the face adaptor, plane and plane location fail 3 each, and the cylinder and its location, axis and direction 2 each. Sending descriptor bounds or the model's volume back through Replicad fails 5 and 14, and drawing circle, rectangle or path profiles with Replicad's pen fails 1 each: the refused-arc, refused-line and fresh-module sector tests. Checks after these changes: full Vitest 619 files and 7163 tests pass; npm run build, lint (zero findings, including the precision literal check over 604 files), ui:check and check-release on its own and against origin/main pass. Single Chromium specs, each alone with 2 workers on a production build: cad-kernel (2), cad-workflow (32) and cad-plane-selection-section (6), all passed. All 24 parity bodies still match the 0.0.789 fingerprints. Before review round 2: Since review round 1: SimplifyResult's third argument is OpenCascade's angular tolerance in radians, so the role is now kernelBooleanSimplifyRad, documented as the angle within which tangent faces and edges of a boolean result merge, listed with the angular roles and ordered between the angular roundoff cap and the tessellation angle; its value stays 0.001 and CAD_PRECISION_VERSION stays 2. Replicad's curve queries, Face.normalAt, makePln and Drawing.translate and rotate left a gp_Pnt, gp_XYZ copies or a gp_Trsf2d behind on every rebuild, topology inspection and section, and the shell left the copy NCollection_List.Append returns; the topology descriptors, sections and circle, rectangle and slot profiles now use cadKernelQueries.ts and cadKernelTranslateDrawing and cadKernelRotateDrawing, which delete everything they make, and the shell deletes the copy. The native-object watch now also records the native objects named methods return, such as Normalized, Multiplied, Value, XYZ, a builder's Shape and Append. New and changed tests: the extrusion vector's two intermediates are counted and only the returned vector is left; curve start, end, points and tangents on lines, circles and half-circle arcs, face normals on a cut box, a mirrored box and a sphere, and section planes equal Replicad's own, number for number, and leave nothing; profile translations and rotations of a circle, a rectangle and a slot equal Replicad's, curve for curve and wire for wire, and leave no 2D transform, vector or point; two controls show the watch sees what Replicad's own queries and Drawing.translate leave; cadKernelRebuildMemory also counts points, directions, vectors, planes, curve and surface adaptors, 2D transforms and the method results, without a garbage collection first, over the 20 holed-plate rebuilds, the six parts, a box with an angled slot, topology inspection of every edge and face of a holed box and of the heavy pattern, sections across XY and XZ, and a selected-edge fillet and chamfer. A one-off probe of every OpenCascade constructor, instance method and static function, without Handle_ results, found nothing left after garbage collection on the 16 parity parts, in inspection, sections, selected-edge fillets and chamfers, or STEP and STL export; before these fixes it found the gp_Trsf2d, points, copies and Append copy above. Before collection only Replicad's GProp_GProps remain, which its garbage-collection scopes release. Mutation round 3, 20 mutations against the 77 tests of the adapter and rebuild-memory suites, each reverted, and every one fails: the model's extrusion vector delete, round 2's survivor, fails 14 tests and the unit vector's delete 17; the curve point 8, the tangent's point and derivative 3 each, the face normal's property object, point and vector 4 each, and the plane's point and direction 5 each; the gp_Trsf2d and gp_GTrsf2d 20 each, the translation vector 17, the rotation centre 4 and the shell's Append copy 1; and sending descriptor start points, face normals, section tangents, circle profiles or slot rotations back through Replicad fails 4, 3, 1, 11 and 1. All 24 parity bodies still match the 0.0.789 fingerprints. The memory and build-time figures below were measured before these fixes and were not run again. Checks after these changes: full Vitest 618 files and 7091 tests pass; npm run build, lint (zero findings, including the precision literal check over 603 files), ui:check and check-release on its own and against origin/main pass. Single Chromium specs, each alone with 2 workers on a production build: cad-kernel (2), cad-workflow (32) and cad-plane-selection-section (6), all passed. Before review round 1: New unit suites: cadKernelBuilders (fuse, cut, common, translate, rotate, mirror through XY, XZ and YZ, scale, and all-edge fillet and chamfer each serialize to the same BRep as Replicad's own call, character for character; each deletes its builder, raw result and every point, direction, vector and axis it makes, and leaves its inputs valid; each deletes its builder and keeps its inputs valid when its native builder fails through cadKernelBuilderFactory; the extrusion vector and the revolve axis along three directions equal Replicad's and leave no temporary; CadKernelPlane at three frames gives Replicad's Plane and the same sketch wire, refuses a null normal or x direction and releases what it made, and leaves no vector or axis of the plane or of a sketch placed on it; faces with 0, 1 and 2 holes match Replicad's sketch faces), cadKernelParity (16 parts and 24 bodies, every benchmark step among them, plus a near-full-turn circular pattern, compared with fingerprints of volume, solid, face and edge counts, bounds and an FNV-1a hash of the exact preview buffer bytes, recorded on 0.0.789 with Replicad's own operations; all 24 match, also after the merge with 0.0.792) and cadKernelRebuildMemory (20 back-to-back rebuilds of the benchmark holed plate leave no counted builder, transform or coordinate system after any rebuild and keep the OpenCascade heap the same size; one build each of revolve-mirror-transform, datum-pad-revolve, loft-sweep-pocket, shell-fillet, box-chamfer-all and near-full-turn-pattern leaves none). The precision policy test pins kernelBooleanSimplifyRad at 0.001 in the version 2 record and orders it between the angular roundoff cap and the tessellation angle. The fault-injection tests of cuts, distance cuts, Pocket, loft, sweep, linear and circular patterns, shape ownership, sketches and datum planes, and the Join count spies, moved from Replicad's shape prototypes to cadKernelBuilderFactory and cadKernelBuilders with the same assertions. Mutations, each reverted. Round 1, 11 mutations against the 461 kernel tests: deleting no boolean builder fails 31 tests, no boolean raw result 28, no transform builder 22, no gp_Trsf 22, no fillet builder 2, no chamfer builder 2, no plane 1 and no sketch face builder 2, and skipping the second Build() fails 19, including the near-full-turn parity part; the axis temporaries and the model's revolve axis survived, so the native-object watch was added. Round 2, 15 mutations against the 78 tests of the new and converted suites: the axis temporaries fail 5, the model's revolve axis 2, the second Build() 4, the scaled vector 3, the translation vector 2, the rotation axis 4, the mirror axis 7, direction 6 and origin 6, the scale origin 2, the plane constructor 1, the sketch Ax2 temporaries 3, the sketch axis 10 and the face holes 1; only the extrusion vector's last intermediate survives, as Multiplied returns it and no constructor watch can see it, and main already deletes it the same way. Memory over 100 rebuilds in fresh modules, 0.0.789 at ef007299 against this branch, 12 parts settled and 13 back to back: settled, 5 of the 12 grew by 27.1 to 244.1 MiB on 0.0.789 and none here; back to back, they grew by up to 979.1 MiB and the imported STL body cut by a slot from 1,543.1 to 4,023.1 MiB with 5 of 100 rebuilds failing, against no growth and no failure here; after the final collection 0.0.789 left a gp_Trsf and two gp_Ax3 for every sketch placement and a transform builder for every pattern copy, mirror and transform, and this branch left none of the counted classes. Build time: 36 back-to-back pairs of 15 uncached builds after 2 warm-ups, three rounds for each of 12 parts with the order alternating by round, and 7 pairs run again because another session's process overlapped them; the best minimum here is 0 to 6% below 0.0.789's on every part, and single-round paired ratios range from 0.90 to 1.06. Two pairs of the legacy cad:benchmark ran throttled on this shared machine, with calibration from 60 to 270 ms against 57 to 84 ms for the recorded baseline, and the second overlapped another process in all five attempts, so their build and edit times are not compared; their memory after 50 edits fell from 127.1 to 100 MiB for the holed plate and from 238.9 to 199.1 MiB for the gear and plate, and stayed at 100 MiB for the box fillet (docs/maintainers/cad-performance.md). After merging main at 0.0.792 (1e396001): full Vitest 618 files and 7070 tests pass; npm run build, lint (zero findings, including the precision literal check over 602 files), ui:check and check-release on its own and against origin/main pass. Single Chromium specs, each alone with 2 workers on a production build: cad-kernel (2), cad-workflow (32) and cad-plane-selection-section (6), all passed. No controller or machine verification is claimed.

publicNotes.summary: Long CAD editing sessions no longer use more and more memory.
changes: Rebuilding a part after an edit releases the kernel memory the previous build used. Parts with patterns, cuts or imported bodies no longer grow the kernel's memory with every edit until rebuilds slow down or fail.
A sketch profile with a line of no length or an arc that cannot be made is now reported as an invalid profile, not as an internal kernel error.
publicNotes.compatibility: Installed machine packages, posts, saved revisions, CAD files and controller output are unchanged. Parts build the same geometry as before.
